python_unittest.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m unittest discover -s flash_v4/tests -p 'test*.py' -v

original_failure.cause: The prior harness expected a colliding put to evict the first key. The current cache probes up to 16 slots and keeps both keys when space remains.
original_failure.original_result: assertion failure; preserved in the CPU test log

updated_semantics: a seventeenth key in a full probe set is not cached and does not evict existing entries
updating an existing key replaces its value without evicting neighbors

minimal_runtime: Current flash_v1 modules: analysis.py, train.py, train_pipeline.py, megatron_adapter.py, pipeline_adapter.py, tensor_parallel.py, rank_layout.py
Megatron-Core pipeline schedule API used by the schedule hooks
For online distributed execution: PyTorch, torch.distributed, torchrun, CUDA and NCCL/Gloo/Store-capable runtime across two 8-GPU nodes
For observer native build: C++17 compiler, pthread, CUDA toolkit/cudart, NCCL headers; set CUDA_HOME and NCCL_INCLUDE_DIR
For stream-delay native build: nvcc and compatible CUDA architecture; build script defaults FLASH_V4_DELAY_CUDA_ARCH to 90
release_dependencies.validated_platform_limit: handoff.md reports the r92 Store interface verified only with PyTorch 2.7.0a0 nv25.03 for supervised 16-rank runs; arbitrary versions and unbounded sessions are not established.

external_transport.recommendation: Keep the private transport helper and its credentials outside the GitHub release.

frozen_inference_portability.verification_behavior: online_infer.run verifies receipt['model'] plus receipt['source_files'] by hashing Path(item['path']) directly; it does not resolve relative to the checkout.
frozen_inference_portability.portability_result: A normal clone or relocated checkout will fail verification unless the original absolute path is reproduced.
frozen_inference_portability.reproduction_note: For portable inference, resolve relative paths from a declared repo/model root and regenerate a matching receipt; full freeze/validation reproduction also requires the receipt provenance artifacts and R11 source data.

credential_audit.scope: text scan of flash_v4 source/test/build files only
credential_audit.conclusion: No common embedded credential pattern found in flash_v4; this does not audit the external helper or private execution plans.

documentation_gaps: No README or user-facing install/run guide under flash_v4.
No requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, setup.py, setup.cfg, or tox.ini dependency/packaging manifest.
PROTOCOL.md describes experimental constraints but does not provide a reproducible environment/build/deployment recipe.
candidate_release_scope: flash_v4 Python source, native source/includes/build scripts, tests, and PROTOCOL.md as one unit
Required current flash_v1 runtime modules or a separately pinned/package-declared dependency
R11 model and receipt plus the six hash-pinned source files for frozen inference
Input observation files for each reproduced inference; provenance and R11 evidence artifacts for full experiment reproduction
